data.description: Implements every StorageFactory, StorageBackend and ReadSnapshot operation over the existing project SQLite file. Owns all production SQL, row mapping, schema/seeding and computer registration in storage/sqlite/. WAL read transactions pin consistent views while atomic immediate write transactions apply validation, resource/readToken guards, changes, versions, receipts and one revision. Schema 14 preserves IDs/history/drafts/legacy receipts and seeds previously unversioned resources. Initialized registered reads are write-free. Desktop and MCP use the shared selecting ProjectStore without Connection access; QA shell execution and local caches stay outside the backend.
data.name: SQLite Storage Adapter
